title: Our New Neighbour
question: Why is Nigel a lucky man?
questionZh: 为什么奈杰尔是个幸运的人？
text:
Why is Nigel a lucky man?

Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.
He's a pilot.
He was in the R.A.F.
He will fly to New York next month.
The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.
At the moment, he's in Madrid.
He flew to Spain a week ago.
He'll return to London the week after next.
He's only forty-one years old, and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
Nigel is a very lucky man.
But his wife isn't very lucky.
She usually stays at home!

bodyTextZh:
奈杰尔是我们的新邻居，住在我们隔壁。
他是一名飞行员。
他曾在英国皇家空军（R.A.F.）服役。
他下个月将飞往纽约。
下下个月，他将飞往东京。
目前，他在马德里。
他一周前飞去了西班牙。
他将在下下周回到伦敦。
他才四十一岁。他已经去过世界上几乎所有的国家了。
奈杰尔是个非常幸运的人。
不过他的妻子运气不太好。
她通常待在家里！
